reason: The primary Study 1 report identifies the randomized coat and scarf groups and their final participant counts. Target is the main generosity comparison across those separate-evaluation groups. Overall recruitment N and joint extension are not the target analytic N.
location: Publisher HTML canonical lines L303–L315 (Participants; Replication of Study 1: The Gift scenario), L326–L328 (main measure), L346–L347 (separate-evaluations generosity test)
quote: Coat condition presented a coat on the lower end of a $50- $500 price range (N = 135): ... The Scarf condition was similar, but instead of a coat they were given a scarf which was on the higher end of a much lower price range $5 to $50 (N = 131):
